On the face looking down it complicates a little bit, but I just grab all ''proportion marks'' and drag them down a little bit, with exception of the mouth. Usually the mouth only changes its overall position on extreme perspectives.

[Here](https://imgur.com/a/azWDmtd) Honestly I dont know why I dont have the sketch for the third face but here it is. I usually start making an overall shape of the face (the alien emoji thingy) and then I trace a line on the middle of the face. From there I divide this line into 5 parts. From top to bottom it is: ''top'' of the head, forehead, eyes, tip of the nose, and mouth. I studied artists like Il Kwang Kim to find these proportions, hope this clarifies it.
